Fixed the `include_psl_private_domains` option being ignored when stored on the TLDExtract constructor.

The bug was in `_PublicSuffixListTLDExtractor.suffix_index()`: when `include_psl_private_domains=None` (the default when not passed at call time), it was treated as falsy and always used the exclude-private trie. The `tlds()` method already had the correct fallback (`if include_psl_private_domains is None: include_psl_private_domains = self.include_psl_private_domains`), but `suffix_index()` was missing it.

The fix adds the same `is None` fallback check to `suffix_index()` so it correctly uses the extractor's stored `include_psl_private_domains` value when not overridden by a call-time argument.
